document.title: Master Direction – Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Based Regulation, 2025

paragraph.body: An NBFC in the Upper Layer shall report its large exposures to the Reserve Bank within 21 days from the end of each quarter.

expected:
Master Direction – Non-Banking Financial Company – Scale Based Regulation, 2025
Chapter IV > Reporting > 4.3A
Applies to: NBFC – Upper Layer, NBFC – Middle Layer
An NBFC in the Upper Layer shall report its large exposures to the Reserve Bank within 21 days from the end of each quarter.
